# italki

> > italki is a global online language learning marketplace connecting students with independent tutors for personalized instruction in Spanish, English, Japanese, and other languages.

italki operates a peer-to-peer language education platform where learners can take conversational practice lessons and receive speaking tips from qualified tutors worldwide. The platform emphasizes practical language learning through one-on-one interaction rather than traditional classroom methods.
